fields.text: What is your preferred tech stack for full-stack projects?

To make your Fiverr gigs more professional and conversion-focused, I have generated five reasonable and high-converting FAQs for each gig. These are designed to address common client concerns while highlighting your specific 6+ years of engineering experience.
Can you build complex systems like CRMs or custom booking engines?

Yes. I have extensive experience building enterprise-level tools, including a custom CRM and a real-time Scheduler for Total Health Dental Care. Whether you need a lead generation platform like TroopHunter or a secure payment app like Honeydu, I can architect it from scratch
How do you ensure the website is fast and performant?

Performance is a priority. I utilize Next.js for server-side rendering, optimize assets using tools like ImagesLoaded, and implement clean code practices to reduce load times. In past projects, I have successfully reduced site load times by 40%
Do you handle the deployment and DevOps part of the project?

Absolutely. Beyond coding, I can manage the entire deployment pipeline using Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD automation. This ensures your application is containerized, scalable, and easily maintainable.
Is the code maintainable for future developers?

Yes. As the Founder of Dev8X, I follow industry-standard 'US-quality' engineering practices. I use TypeScript, ESLint, and Prettier to ensure the codebase is clean, well-documented, and easy for any team to scale in the future.
